# Gimakx

> Gimakx is a B2B manufacturer of custom Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ) Gis, rash guards, and academy apparel. We handle full in-house production — from cutting to final stitching and quality checks — using a premium pre-shrunk 60% cotton / 40% polyester pearl weave and a 100% natural cotton option that is not pre-shrunk, in three fabric weights (380, 450, and 500 gsm), with 270 gsm ripstop cotton trousers. We serve academies, gyms, retailers, and apparel brands worldwide with custom branding, private labeling, and low minimum order quantities (10 units per design).

- Business type: B2B manufacturer (no individual consumer orders)
- Minimum order quantity (MOQ): 10 units per design
- BJJ Gi fabric weights: 380 gsm (GiPro Aerotough — lightest IBJJF-legal weight), 450 gsm (GiPro Fortitude — most popular, default competition weight), 500 gsm (GiPro Monolith — heaviest, maximum durability). Note: 350 gsm is below the IBJJF's 380 gsm competition-legal minimum (2024 rule change) and is not a Gimakx product.
- Rash guard and No-Gi shorts fabric (Evosoft): 240 gsm, 90% polyester / 10% spandex, 4-way stretch, moisture-wicking, anti-bacterial; flatlock stitched; tagless with printed size and care labels
- IBJJF-approved standard cuts and fabrics (within the IBJJF 380–650 gsm legal window)
- Sizes: A0–A4 (men), W1–W4 (women), K0–K4 (kids)
- Colors: 12+ colors available across all three fabric weights; camouflage as special order
- Customization: embroidery, woven patches, sublimation, custom neck labels, branded packaging, private labeling
- Lead times: GiPro Custom Series 3–4 weeks; GiPro Standard Series ships within a few days
- Payment methods: Bank Transfer (TT), Western Union, Payoneer
- Shipping terms: DAP (Delivered At Place, Incoterms 2020) — Gimakx arranges carriage to the delivery address; the customer acts as importer of record
- Freight: paid by the customer, quoted per order in the written quotation (not included in unit pricing)
- Shipping methods and transit times: air by DHL or FedEx, 8–20 days depending on destination and service level; sea 40–50 business days, measured from dispatch — additional to the production lead time
- Export documents: commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin with every shipment; country of origin Pakistan (manufactured in Sialkot)
- Customs duties and import taxes: the buyer's responsibility
- Samples: available on request; terms agreed per customer
- Location: Pakistan (factory-direct)
- Contact: support@gimakx.com | WhatsApp +92 (310) 7197-037

## Products

- [BJJ Gi (GiPro Series)](https://www.gimakx.com/bjj-gi.html): Custom Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Gis in 380, 450, and 500 gsm pre-shrunk pearl weave. Triple-stitched stress points, IBJJF-approved, full academy customization.
- [Evosoft Rash Guards](https://www.gimakx.com/evosoft.html): Fully sublimated 240 gsm rash guards for No-Gi and under-Gi training. Custom academy logos, sponsors, and color themes.
- [Apparels](https://www.gimakx.com/apparels.html): Academy apparel including GiStrix T-shirts and GiFlex hoodies with custom branding.
- [Accessories](https://www.gimakx.com/accessories.html): Custom badges, belts, Gi bags, caps, and other academy accessories.

## Guides

- [BJJ Gi Fabric Weights: 380 vs 450 vs 500 GSM](https://www.gimakx.com/guides/bjj-gi-fabric-weights.html): Manufacturer's guide explaining what GSM means and comparing 380 gsm (Aerotough, lightweight — kids/hot climates/weight-cutters), 450 gsm (Fortitude, mid-weight — where adult beginners start, and the most popular default competition weight), and 500 gsm (Monolith, heavyweight — instructors/masters, grip resistance, max durability). Covers feel, durability, climate, care, IBJJF legality (all three sit inside the IBJJF 380–650 gsm window), and why 350 gsm is not competition-legal.
- [Start a BJJ Academy Risk-Free: The Gimakx Partnership Program](https://www.gimakx.com/guides/bjj-academy-partnership-program.html): How new BJJ academy owners partner with Gimakx risk-free — first order of just 10 custom Gis (mixed sizes allowed), a free personalised mockup with the academy's logo and colours, no contracts or reorder obligations, and a 30-day Local Promotion Program (up to $50 of targeted local ads behind the academy's video content, aimed at people searching for BJJ lessons nearby). Includes the 4-step onboarding process and a comparison with typical bulk vendors.
- [BJJ Gi Size Chart: A0–A4, W1–W4, K0–K4](https://www.gimakx.com/guides/bjj-gi-size-chart.html): Full height-by-weight size charts for men's (A0–A4), women's (W1–W4) and kids' (K0–K4) BJJ Gis. Covers how to read the chart, the quick weight ranges per size (A2 is the most ordered adult size at 156–225 lbs), what to do when you fall between two sizes, 1–3% shrinkage on pre-shrunk pearl weave, and ordering mixed sizes within the 10-unit MOQ.
- [Guides Hub](https://www.gimakx.com/guides/): Index of Gimakx BJJ Gi guides on fabric, sizing, and buying for academies.
